events.title: Notoris 2: Warlords Discord is now open.
events.summary: The Notoris 2: Warlords Discord is now open.The demo is out, and I’d like to start getting more feedback from people playing it.Notoris 2 is still being actively developed, and there are a lot of things I’m still figuring out. If you’ve played the demo, I’d love to hear what you liked, what you didn’t, what felt confusing, and what you’d like to see added or changed. If you want to follow development, give feedback, or just talk about the game, you can join here:https://discord.com/invite/S4HrqV

events.title: Notoris 2: Warlords | Dev Update
events.summary: July was a super productive month, with a heavy focus on Diplomacy, officer relationships, progression systems, and AI improvements. A key milestone was reached as core gameplay systems began interacting in previously unattainable ways, resulting in the game reaching a fully playable state. It was wild to suddenly have this collection of systems you’ve been working on for 4+ years turn into a playable game in a single month..
